content:
maria-support: hi team — ACME reported a sharp p99 spike starting ~07:12 UTC, went from ~210ms -> ~1.8s and many requests show an unexpected eu-central hop. customer is pinned to us-west. ticket: #54321
jana-obs: thanks, can you paste the trace id(s)? any correlation ids?
maria-support: trace id `trace-8f3a` attached in the ticket. quick repro curl they ran: `curl -H "x-tenant-id: acme" https://api.redwood.example/generate` — saw the slow tail around tokens 120-200
tracebot: uploaded trace-8f3a (link: https://traces.redwood/trace-8f3a) :spiral_note_pad:
tony-sre: looking at the trace — I see request enters us-west edge, then routes to auth-cache-us, then jumps to eu-central-proxy (10.4.12.7) before returning to us-east-runtime. Routing table entry changed?
jana-obs: full span list (short):
```
us-west-edge -> auth-cache-us -> eu-central-proxy -> us-east-runtime -> response
```
latencies: auth-cache-us 40ms, eu-central-proxy 1.2s, us-east-runtime 30ms
mar ia-support: typo in the last message^^ meant maria-support :sweat_smile:
ingrid-customer: this started after we pushed a region affinity header change last week — we only saw few errors but now latency for some customers is bad. any ETA?
maria-support: forwarded to infra earlier — tag @tony-sre
tony-sre: prelim hypotheses: 1) fallback policy evaluation failing to respect tenant region annotation, 2) recent edge LB config (commit `lb-2026-03-04`) may be incorrectly mapping origin IP ranges to default route set, 3) auth cache miss causing fallback to global proxy.
jana-obs: I pulled router logs for edge-us-west (log snippet):
```
[07:11:54] req=trace-8f3a tenant=acme hint_region=us-west route=evaluate -> fallback set=global-proxy
[07:11:54] rule_eval: tenant_region_tag=us-west, route_match=false, fallback_reason=missing-kv
```
looks like route_match returned false even though tag exists 

tony-sre: can you grep for tag retrieval? Should be call to route-db v2: `GET /routes/tenant/acme` — if that returned 404 we get fallback.
maria-support: attaching proxy logs from eu-central-proxy: `upstream: us-east-runtime (healthy), received request for tenant acme, origin-edge us-west`
jana-obs: I ran a quick local repro with headers and added `x-tenant-region: us-west` — requests stayed in us-west path. So header works. Might be intermittent KV store TTL expiration during that time.
ingrid-customer: we have billing impact — can we scope which tenants affected?
jana-obs: running a query for last 2 hours, I see ~14 tenants had at least one trace that hopped to eu-central; top two are acme and beta-co. Pattern: both had recent metadata updates 7-8 minutes before spikes.
tony-sre: that points to race between metadata write and route cache invalidation. Recent code change: cache invalidation was switched from eventual->sync in `routes-service` (PR #891) but rollback might have a bug where the cache key uses `tenant_id` vs `tenant_id:region` so a quick re-rollover would temporarily not match.
maria-support: proposed mitigation?
tony-sre: immediate: 1) pin affected tenants to the us-west route via a temporary override in the route-matcher (manual patch), 2) revert PR #891 on routes-service, 3) scrape all edge logs for the 07:10-07:20 window and notify customers. I'll start 1 and 2.
deploy-bot: deploy started for hotfix `route-pin-acme-2026-03-17` -> edge-us-west, edge-us-east (CI run green)
jana-obs: after route-pin applied the traces for new requests show direct us-west path again, p99 back down to ~230ms.
ingrid-customer: thanks — can you add this incident summary and whether there's a billing credit we can offer?
maria-support: will draft a customer note and propose pro-rated credits for the spike window.
tony-sre: follow-ups: 1) add stronger instrumentation to route-db cache misses, 2) run a controlled test of metadata churn to ensure no transient fallbacks, 3) add alerting for cross-region egress increase above baseline. I'll open tickets.
jana-obs: creating postmortem stub and linking traces + commits.
maria-support: closing loop with ACME, attaching the hotfix reference and ETA for permanent fix (aiming EOD). thanks all. :white_check_mark:
